name: get_plan_prompt
description: Get the full instructions for planning a system configuration change of the given type (new installation, vacation mode, room addition, etc.) -- workflow, what to ask the customer, and how to use pair_device/create_folder/propose_scene/propose_automation/propose_variable/review_plan/revise_plan/apply_plan together. Call this ONCE, first, before any other plan tool, at the start of any conversation that turns out to need one of these -- it is deliberately left out of the standing system prompt since most conversations never need it. Currently only plan_type='new_installation' is implemented; every other recognized value returns a not-yet-available message instead of instructions -- check for that before telling the customer you're proceeding.

plan_type.description: Which kind of plan the customer wants. Only "new_installation" is currently functional -- every other value is a recognized but not-yet-available plan type. Defaults to "new_installation" if omitted.
